profile.name: Ridhan Firdaus
profile.about: I'm an IT graduate working across four connected areas. As a data analyst I turn raw records into clean datasets, dashboards and reports that drive decisions. As a NOC engineer I monitor networks, triage incidents and keep services up. As a web developer I build responsive web apps from interface to database, and as an AI engineer I apply machine learning and LLMs to automate work and surface insights. The projects below bring these skills together.

focus.title: Data Analyst
focus.text: Cleaning and modelling data, writing queries, and building dashboards and recurring reports that answer a specific business question.

focus.title: NOC Engineer
focus.text: Monitoring network health 24/7, responding to incidents, and keeping devices, links and documentation in order so services stay up.

focus.title: Web Developer
focus.text: Building responsive web apps end to end: interfaces, REST APIs and databases, shipped with clean, maintainable code.

focus.title: AI Engineer
focus.text: Applying machine learning and large language models to real problems: prompt design, retrieval pipelines and models that automate repetitive work.

projects.title: YourMajor Recommendation
projects.desc: Recommends university major categories from a student's 8 UTBK scores using K-Nearest Neighbors: it finds the students with the most similar score profile among 86,569 UTBK 2019 Saintek participants and ranks the majors they chose. Built with Muhammad Izzat and Nicholas Calvin.

projects.title: Sneaker Analyst
projects.desc: Analyzes sneaker sales data to find sales trends and top-performing products, with a dashboard of sales by country, top products and brands, the 2022 monthly trend, payment methods, and average unit price by gender and category.

projects.title: Flight Price Prediction
projects.desc: An end-to-end machine learning project that predicts flight ticket prices from flight features: it compares several regression models, tunes the best one and serves predictions through a Streamlit app.

projects.title: Car Logo Prediction
projects.desc: A deep learning computer-vision model that classifies car logos into five brands (Audi, Bentley, BMW, Mercedes and Toyota), trained with image preprocessing and data augmentation and deployed as a Streamlit app.
